name: @seekrit/openclaw-plugin
description: seekrit for OpenClaw — resolve exec SecretRefs from end-to-end encrypted secrets, so the gateway config holds no plaintext and the seekrit API never sees one.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(!/^pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'')){console.error('Publish with pnpm: npm publish leaves pnpm catalog and workspace specifiers in the manifest, and the package will not install.');process.exit(1)}"
